what: A well-formed product surface whose robots.txt PERMITS the product page and FORBIDS three paths its legs probe. Partial, not uniform: the page is read, some of what it offers cannot be.
why: The seven-fixture set had no mode in which a product's own robots.txt forbids a probe a rule needs, so harness-v5's BLIND/SCOPE change moved 0 derived control rows and the class it was built to catch was never exercised by the gate.

forbidden.note: the whole-product download A3 asks for, reached as a link on the page
the latest-vintage pointer A8 resolves, and a link A1 and A3 probe
a link on the page; B3 reads the PAGE and never fetches this, which is why B3 is not in this list

allowed.note: the product page itself: every leg that reads only the surface stays observed
a structured distribution, so A1 still has an observed link that serves one
A2 and A9's machine entry point

partition_is_declared_not_inferred: DD-061. The paths above are chosen from the leg -> collector -> method table `fixture_expectations.leg_probes` derives from collector source, never from reading a rule module. Which legs each forbidden path blinds is a property of what the COLLECTORS dispatch.

legs_that_cannot_be_forbidden_by_a_parti.why: each reads only the surface page (http.fetch or structured_data.fetch on the surface URL). Forbidding the page blinds every one of them at once, which is `resets_connection`, not a partition. A robots partition can separate legs only where the legs dereference something.

always_fetch_paths_are_unblockable.why: manners.always_fetch_paths short-circuits allowed() to True, so A4, A5, A12 and D4 cannot be blinded by a Disallow even in principle. That carve-out is deliberate: a robots.txt that disallows /robots.txt cannot thereby hide it from a measurement OF robots.txt.
